changes.title: Incomplete question rates
changes.text: Custom questions now show an unknown rate when both totals are incomplete, and label individual positive or negative bounds correctly.

changes.title: Large rate display
changes.text: Large custom-question rates no longer shrink when their two-decimal display exceeds the integer rounding range.

changes.title: Rate-bound regression checks
changes.text: Added exact, incomplete, negative, zero and large-rate cases, plus native Android answer-window checks.

changes.title: Rate and delivery evidence
changes.text: Recorded the preceding verified APK and the reproduced rate-display failures and successful targeted checks.

changes.title: Developer Commentary
changes.text: I corrected misleading rate answers when recordings are incomplete. Large rates also retain their represented value instead of being clipped by display rounding.
